title: [BUG] --allowedTools ignored, and claude not able to use tools
body:
despite I call --allowedTools, before and after flags and never works:

```
claude \
  --output-format stream-json \
  --allowedTools "Bash(*)" Edit Write Replace Agent Glob Grep LS Read \
  -p \
  "$@"
```


returns **"Please grant permission to the Bash tool so I can rename your branch."** , but I already granted it!

